• Belgique
• Contrats
• Temps partiel
• Flocon de neige, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client in Basel, we are looking for a Senior Clinical Scientist. The ideal candidate holds an advanced degree (PhD or Master's) and 5+ years of clinical science experience, specializing in neurological indications like Multiple Sclerosis and Alzheimer’s Disease. They excel at authoring critical Phase 2–3 study documents, including protocols, ICFs, and clinical study reports. As a sharp analytical thinker, they expertly lead clinical data review, data cleaning, and interpretation to drive informed trial decisions.

Location: Basel

Contract duration: 31.12.2027/possible extension

Responsibilities:
• Your activities will include the development and writing of study documentation including protocols, informed consent forms, clinical study reports, as well as clinical science input for study-specific operational and regulatory documents.
• You will be responsible for ongoing monitoring of clinical activities and study conduct, coordination of data collection, data review, analysis, and interpretation as well as preparation and presentation of results for informed decision-making.
• You will be the main point of contact for data management regarding periodic clinical data review and data cleaning
• You will participate in study management, as clinical science representative, to ensure trial deliverables are met according to timelines, budget, quality standards and operational procedures, within a global multidisciplinary cross-functional Study Management Team (SMT)
• You will provide training and science input to operation colleagues and study site staff, as agreed with clinical operations
• You will monitor study progress on a regular basis to identify any problems or issues that could affect the results or completion of the study; you will investigate and employ problem-solving strategies.
• You should bring a positive, energetic, responsible, creative, curious and solution-seeking mindset and proactively contribute to interdisciplinary clinical project teams with integrity, passion and courage.

Must Haves:
• PhD or Masters with extensive work experience as a clinical scientists
• 5+ years the clinical scientist role in different neurological indications, preference for Multiple Sclerosis and Alzheimer’s Disease
• You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a proven track record in clinical data review, analysis, and reporting data.
• You have a solid understanding of clinical development processes (phase 2-3), study design principles, and international clinical research and safety guidelines. *
• You are a collaborative, solution-oriented scientist who communicates effectively across teams, values diverse perspectives, and makes sound, independent decisions.
• You have excellent written, oral communication, and presentation skills.
• Fluency in English

Job profile
• Life Sciences - Clinical & Safety
• Basel-Landschaft
• Contracting
• Part Time, 100%
• As soon as possible - 31.12.2027/Possible extensionn
• Clinical science, CNS, GCP

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per il nostro cliente a Basilea, stiamo cercando uno scienziato clinico senior. Il candidato ideale detiene un grado avanzato (PhD o Master) e 5+ anni di esperienza scientifica clinica, specializzata in indicazioni neurologiche come la sclerosi multipla e la malattia di Alzheimer. Essi eccellono nell'autore di documenti di studio critici di Fase 2-3, compresi i protocolli, ICF e rapporti di studio clinici. Come pensatore analitico acuto, conducono sapientemente la revisione dei dati clinici, la pulizia dei dati e l'interpretazione per guidare le decisioni di prova informate.

Posizione: Basilea

Durata del contratto: 31.12.2027/possibile estensione

Responsabilità:
• Le vostre attività includono lo sviluppo e la scrittura della documentazione di studio, compresi i protocolli, i moduli di consenso informati, i rapporti di studio clinici, nonché l'ingresso di scienza clinica per i documenti operativi e regolamentari specifici dello studio.
• Sarete responsabili del monitoraggio continuo delle attività cliniche e della condotta di studio, del coordinamento della raccolta dei dati, della revisione dei dati, dell'analisi e dell'interpretazione, nonché della preparazione e della presentazione dei risultati per il processo decisionale informato.
• Sarà il punto di contatto principale per la gestione dei dati relativi alla revisione periodica dei dati clinici e alla pulizia dei dati
• Parteciperai alla gestione dello studio, come rappresentante della scienza clinica, per garantire che i risultati delle prove siano soddisfatti in base a tempi, budget, standard di qualità e procedure operative, all'interno di un team multidisciplinare multifunzionale di gestione dello studio (SMT)
• Fornirai formazione e input scientifico ai colleghi operativi e personale del sito di studio, come concordato con le operazioni cliniche
• Monitorerai i progressi dello studio regolarmente per identificare eventuali problemi o problemi che potrebbero influenzare i risultati o il completamento dello studio; studierai e userai strategie di risoluzione dei problemi.
• Si dovrebbe portare una mentalità positiva, energica, responsabile, creativa, curiosa e alla ricerca di soluzioni e contribuire proattivamente a team di progetto clinici interdisciplinari con integrità, passione e coraggio.

Deve avere:
• PhD o Masters con una vasta esperienza di lavoro come scienziati clinici
• 5+ anni il ruolo di scienziato clinico in diverse indicazioni neurologiche, la preferenza per la sclerosi multipla e la malattia di Alzheimer
• Possiedi forti competenze analitiche e quantitative, con un record di traccia provata nella revisione dei dati clinici, analisi e report dei dati.
• Hai una solida comprensione dei processi di sviluppo clinico (fase 2-3), dei principi di progettazione dello studio e delle linee guida cliniche e di sicurezza internazionali. *
• Sei uno scienziato collaborativo e orientato alla soluzione che comunica efficacemente tra team, valori di prospettive diverse, e prende decisioni solide e indipendenti.
• Hai eccellenti capacità di scrittura, comunicazione orale e presentazione.
• Fluency in inglese

Profilo del lavoro
• Scienze della vita - Clinical & Safety
• Basilea-Landschaft
• Contraente
• Tempo parziale, 100%
• Non appena possibile - 31.12.2027/Possible extendn
• Scienza clinica, CNS, GCP

jobs.description:
In this role, you will lead small to medium initiatives, prioritize effectively with stakeholders, and maintain a "bigger picture" view of how various components align with the overall strategy. You will analyze complex business problems to recommend automated solutions, identify and implement process improvements, and optimize system configurations for peak efficiency.

Tasks & Responsibilities:
• You Take ownership of ambiguous tasks and topics in the "grey zone" (where there is no defined owner) and successfully drive small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the project, squad, or product level.
• You Challenge the status quo, skillfully navigate group dynamics in diversified settings, and foster good collaboration, coaching, and mentoring. You Analyze complex business problems to recommend automated system solutions, identify process improvements, optimize system configurations, and design and implement system integrations.
• Stakeholder Management: You prioritize and communicate with stakeholders effectively. Maintain a bigger picture view to thoroughly understand how various technical components fit into the overall product strategy and goals.
• You act as a technical mentor and align development plans with the global strategy. Actively give speeches and share knowledge in internal events (e.g., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live). Engage in the organization of knowledge-sharing events and get involved in initiatives or tasks reaching outside of the regular project scope.
• You operate at the Product or Site level, making a direct impact on the technical decisions within the product and the ways of working of other chapter members. Lead cross-functional linked teams to address business or systems issues.
• You possess a deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond the specific component being worked on. Formulate and implement technical strategies aligned with organizational objectives, and invest time and energy in initiatives that boost creativity and innovation while maintaining the highest engineering quality.

Must Haves:
• Minimum Bachelor within relevant field of IT or Business
• Min 5 years of industry experience with solid GXP knowledge, Validation experience, Quality knowledge
• Proven expertise in analyzing complex business challenges to design, optimize, test, and implement automated enterprise solutions, system configurations, and integrations aligned with organizational goals.
• Demonstrated ability to independently take ownership of ambiguous problems, challenge the status quo, and drive small-to-medium project or product - level initiatives that deliver measurable process improvements.
• Track record of leading cross-functional teams to solve critical systems issues while mentoring peers, facilitating knowledge sharing, and aligning diverse technical stakeholders.
• Proficiency in developing comprehensive test strategies and plans and excellent problem-solving.
• Expertise in optimizing system configurations and settings for efficiency and performance and deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond immediate components.
• Strong communication in English and stakeholder management skills, capable of prioritizing effectively and maintaining a "bigger picture" view of how technical components fit organizational goals.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In questo ruolo, si porterà piccole a medie iniziative, priorità efficacemente con gli stakeholder, e mantenere una visione "grande immagine" di come i vari componenti si allineano con la strategia generale. Analizzerai problemi di business complessi per consigliare soluzioni automatizzate, identificare e implementare miglioramenti di processo, e ottimizzare le configurazioni di sistema per la massima efficienza.

Compiti e responsabilità:
• Prendere la proprietà di compiti e argomenti ambigui nella "zona grande" (dove non c'è proprietario definito) e guidare con successo piccole a medie (S/M) iniziative a livello di progetto, squadra o prodotto.
• Sfida lo status quo, naviga abilmente le dinamiche di gruppo in ambienti diversificati, e favorisce una buona collaborazione, coaching e mentoring. Analizza complessi problemi aziendali per consigliare soluzioni di sistema automatizzate, identificare miglioramenti di processo, ottimizzare le configurazioni di sistema, e progettare e implementare integrazioni di sistema.
• Gestione degli stakeholder: priorità e comunicazione con gli stakeholder in modo efficace. Mantenere una visione d'immagine più grande per capire a fondo come vari componenti tecnici si adattano alla strategia e agli obiettivi del prodotto generale.
• Agite come mentore tecnico e allineate i piani di sviluppo con la strategia globale. Attivare i discorsi e condividere le conoscenze in eventi interni (ad esempio, DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live). Impegnarsi nell'organizzazione di eventi di condivisione della conoscenza e partecipare a iniziative o compiti che raggiungono al di fuori dell'ambito di progetto regolare.
• L'utente opera a livello del Prodotto o del Sito, assumendo un impatto diretto sulle decisioni tecniche all'interno del prodotto e sulle modalità di lavoro di altri membri del capitolo. Lead team collegati trasversalmente per affrontare problemi di business o sistemi.
• Possiedi una profonda comprensione del paesaggio tecnico più ampio oltre la componente specifica su cui si lavora. Formulare e implementare strategie tecniche allineate agli obiettivi organizzativi e investire tempo ed energia in iniziative che favoriscano la creatività e l'innovazione mantenendo al contempo la massima qualità ingegneristica.

Deve avere:
• Corso di laurea minimo nel campo rilevante di IT o Business
• Min 5 anni di esperienza del settore con solida conoscenza GXP, esperienza di convalida, conoscenza della qualità
• Prove competenze nell'analisi di complesse sfide aziendali per progettare, ottimizzare, testare e implementare soluzioni aziendali automatizzate, configurazioni di sistema e integrazioni allineate a obiettivi organizzativi.
• Dimostrata capacità di prendere indipendentemente la proprietà di problemi ambigui, sfidare lo status quo, e guidare il progetto o il prodotto di piccolo-medio - iniziative di livello che forniscono miglioramenti di processo misurabili.
• Tracciare il record dei principali team interfunzionali per risolvere i problemi dei sistemi critici mentre mentoring peers, facilitando la condivisione delle conoscenze e allineando diversi stakeholder tecnici.
• La competenza nello sviluppo di strategie e piani di prova completi e di eccellente problem solving.
• Competenza nell'ottimizzazione delle configurazioni e delle impostazioni di sistema per l'efficienza e le prestazioni e la profonda comprensione del paesaggio tecnico più ampio oltre i componenti immediati.
• Forte comunicazione in inglese e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, in grado di priorizzare efficacemente e mantenere una visione "grande immagine" di come i componenti tecnici si adattano agli obiettivi organizzativi.

Bello da avere:
• Java

Profilo del lavoro
• IT - Gestione della qualità
• Aargau
• Contraente
• Tempo pieno
• Java, Business Analyse
descriptionByLocale.en:
In this role, you will lead small to medium initiatives, prioritize effectively with stakeholders, and maintain a "bigger picture" view of how various components align with the overall strategy. You will analyze complex business problems to recommend automated solutions, identify and implement process improvements, and optimize system configurations for peak efficiency.

Tasks & Responsibilities:
• You Take ownership of ambiguous tasks and topics in the "grey zone" (where there is no defined owner) and successfully drive small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the project, squad, or product level.
• You Challenge the status quo, skillfully navigate group dynamics in diversified settings, and foster good collaboration, coaching, and mentoring. You Analyze complex business problems to recommend automated system solutions, identify process improvements, optimize system configurations, and design and implement system integrations.
• Stakeholder Management: You prioritize and communicate with stakeholders effectively. Maintain a bigger picture view to thoroughly understand how various technical components fit into the overall product strategy and goals.
• You act as a technical mentor and align development plans with the global strategy. Actively give speeches and share knowledge in internal events (e.g., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live). Engage in the organization of knowledge-sharing events and get involved in initiatives or tasks reaching outside of the regular project scope.
• You operate at the Product or Site level, making a direct impact on the technical decisions within the product and the ways of working of other chapter members. Lead cross-functional linked teams to address business or systems issues.
• You possess a deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond the specific component being worked on. Formulate and implement technical strategies aligned with organizational objectives, and invest time and energy in initiatives that boost creativity and innovation while maintaining the highest engineering quality.

Must Haves:
• Minimum Bachelor within relevant field of IT or Business
• Min 5 years of industry experience with solid GXP knowledge, Validation experience, Quality knowledge
• Proven expertise in analyzing complex business challenges to design, optimize, test, and implement automated enterprise solutions, system configurations, and integrations aligned with organizational goals.
• Demonstrated ability to independently take ownership of ambiguous problems, challenge the status quo, and drive small-to-medium project or product - level initiatives that deliver measurable process improvements.
• Track record of leading cross-functional teams to solve critical systems issues while mentoring peers, facilitating knowledge sharing, and aligning diverse technical stakeholders.
• Proficiency in developing comprehensive test strategies and plans and excellent problem-solving.
• Expertise in optimizing system configurations and settings for efficiency and performance and deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond immediate components.
• Strong communication in English and stakeholder management skills, capable of prioritizing effectively and maintaining a "bigger picture" view of how technical components fit organizational goals.

Nice to Haves:
• Java

Job profile
• IT - Quality Management
• Aargau
• Contracting
• Full Time
• Java, Business Analyse
descriptionByLocale.de:
In dieser Rolle leiten Sie kleine bis mittlere Initiativen, priorisieren effektiv mit den Stakeholdern und behalten ein "größeres Bild" darüber, wie verschiedene Komponenten mit der Gesamtstrategie übereinstimmen. Sie analysieren komplexe Geschäftsprobleme, um automatisierte Lösungen zu empfehlen, Prozessverbesserungen zu identifizieren und zu implementieren und Systemkonfigurationen für maximale Effizienz zu optimieren.

Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten:
• Sie übernehmen mehrdeutige Aufgaben und Themen in der "Grauzone" (wo es keinen definierten Eigentümer gibt) und treiben kleine bis mittlere (S / M) Initiativen auf Projekt-, Squad- oder Produktebene erfolgreich voran.
• Sie fordern den Status quo heraus, navigieren geschickt in diversifizierten Umgebungen durch Gruppendynamik und fördern gute Zusammenarbeit, Coaching und Mentoring. Sie analysieren komplexe Geschäftsprobleme, um automatisierte Systemlösungen zu empfehlen, Prozessverbesserungen zu identifizieren, Systemkonfigurationen zu optimieren und Systemintegrationen zu entwerfen und zu implementieren.
• Stakeholder Management: Sie priorisieren und kommunizieren effektiv mit Stakeholdern. Behalten Sie ein größeres Bild, um genau zu verstehen, wie verschiedene technische Komponenten in die gesamte Produktstrategie und -ziele passen.
• Sie agieren als technischer Mentor und richten Entwicklungspläne an der globalen Strategie aus. Aktiv Reden halten und Wissen in internen Veranstaltungen austauschen (z.B. DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live). Beteiligen Sie sich an der Organisation von Veranstaltungen zum Wissensaustausch und beteiligen Sie sich an Initiativen oder Aufgaben, die außerhalb des regulären Projektumfangs liegen.
• Sie arbeiten auf Produkt- oder Websiteebene und haben direkten Einfluss auf die technischen Entscheidungen innerhalb des Produkts und die Arbeitsweise anderer Kapitelmitglieder. Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende verknüpfte Teams, um Geschäfts- oder Systemprobleme zu lösen.
• Sie besitzen ein tiefes Verständnis der breiteren technischen Landschaft jenseits der spezifischen Komponente, an der gearbeitet wird. Formulieren und implementieren Sie technische Strategien, die auf organisatorische Ziele ausgerichtet sind, und investieren Sie Zeit und Energie in Initiativen, die Kreativität und Innovation fördern und gleichzeitig höchste technische Qualität gewährleisten.

Must Haves:
• Mindest-Bachelor in relevanten Bereich IT oder Business
• Min 5 Jahre Branchenerfahrung mit solidem GXP-Wissen, Validierungserfahrung, Qualitätswissen
• Bewährte Expertise bei der Analyse komplexer geschäftlicher Herausforderungen, um automatisierte Unternehmenslösungen, Systemkonfigurationen und Integrationen zu entwerfen, zu optimieren, zu testen und zu implementieren, die auf die organisatorischen Ziele ausgerichtet sind.
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, unabhängig voneinander mehrdeutige Probleme zu übernehmen, den Status quo in Frage zu stellen und Initiativen auf kleiner bis mittlerer Projekt- oder Produktebene voranzutreiben, die messbare Prozessverbesserungen liefern.
• Erfolgsbilanz führender funktionsübergreifender Teams zur Lösung kritischer Systemprobleme bei der Betreuung von Peers, der Erleichterung des Wissensaustauschs und der Ausrichtung verschiedener technischer Interessengruppen.
• Kompetenz in der Entwicklung umfassender Teststrategien und -pläne und ausgezeichnete Problemlösung.
• Expertise in der Optimierung von Systemkonfigurationen und Einstellungen für Effizienz und Leistung sowie ein tiefes Verständnis der breiteren technischen Landschaft jenseits unmittelbarer Komponenten.
• Starke Kommunikation in Englisch und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, die in der Lage sind, effektiv zu priorisieren und ein "größeres Bild" zu erhalten, wie technische Komponenten zu organisatorischen Zielen passen.

Nice to Haves:
• Java

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des initiatives de petite à moyenne envergure, vous prioriserez efficacement les intervenants et vous garderez une vue d'ensemble de la façon dont les divers éléments s'harmonisent avec la stratégie globale. Vous analyserez des problèmes d'affaires complexes pour recommander des solutions automatisées, identifier et mettre en œuvre des améliorations de processus, et optimiser les configurations du système pour une efficacité maximale.

Tâches et responsabilités :
• Vous vous appropriez des tâches et des sujets ambigus dans la « zone grise » (où il n'y a pas de propriétaire défini) et vous conduisez avec succès des initiatives petites à moyennes (S/M) au niveau du projet, de l'équipe ou du produit.
• Vous défiez le statu quo, naviguez habilement dans une dynamique de groupe diversifiée et favorisez une bonne collaboration, un encadrement et un mentorat. Vous analysez des problèmes d'affaires complexes pour recommander des solutions automatisées, identifier les améliorations de processus, optimiser les configurations du système et concevoir et mettre en œuvre des intégrations de systèmes.
• Gestion des intervenants : Vous priorisez et communiquez efficacement avec les intervenants. Maintenir une vue d'ensemble afin de bien comprendre comment divers composants techniques s'inscrivent dans la stratégie et les objectifs globaux du produit.
• Vous agissez en tant que mentor technique et alignez les plans de développement sur la stratégie globale. Donner activement des discours et partager des connaissances dans les événements internes (p. ex., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live). Participer à l'organisation d'événements de partage des connaissances et participer à des initiatives ou à des tâches qui ne relèvent pas de la portée régulière du projet.
• Vous opèrez au niveau du produit ou du site, ce qui a un impact direct sur les décisions techniques au sein du produit et sur les façons de travailler des autres membres du chapitre. Diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles pour régler les problèmes d'affaires ou de systèmes.
• Vous avez une compréhension profonde du paysage technique plus large que la composante spécifique sur laquelle vous travaillez. Formuler et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies techniques alignées sur les objectifs organisationnels, et investir du temps et de l'énergie dans des initiatives qui stimulent la créativité et l'innovation tout en maintenant la plus haute qualité en ingénierie.

Doit avoir :
• Baccalauréat minimum dans le domaine pertinent de l'informatique ou des affaires
• Mini 5 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie avec de solides connaissances GXP, Expérience de validation, Connaissances de qualité
• Expertise éprouvée dans l'analyse de défis d'affaires complexes pour concevoir, optimiser, tester et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'entreprise automatisées, des configurations de système et des intégrations alignées sur les objectifs organisationnels.
• Capacité démontrée de s'approprier de façon indépendante des problèmes ambigus, de remettre en question le statu quo et de mener des initiatives de projets ou de produits de petite à moyenne envergure qui permettent d'améliorer les processus de façon mesurable.
• Faire le suivi des équipes interfonctionnelles de premier plan pour résoudre les problèmes critiques des systèmes tout en tutorant les pairs, en facilitant le partage des connaissances et en alignant les divers intervenants techniques.
• Compétence dans l'élaboration de stratégies et de plans d'essais complets et excellente résolution de problèmes.
• Expertise dans l'optimisation des configurations et des réglages du système pour l'efficacité et la performance et une compréhension approfondie du paysage technique plus large au-delà des composants immédiats.
• Une bonne communication en anglais et des compétences en gestion des intervenants, capables de hiérarchiser efficacement et de maintenir une vue d'ensemble de la façon dont les composantes techniques correspondent aux objectifs organisationnels.

jobs.title: Software & Solution Architect (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Für unseren Kunden aus dem öffentlichen Umfeld suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n Software & Solution Architect zur Konzeption und Umsetzung einer modernen, datenbankgestützten Softwarelösung. In dieser vielseitigen Rolle übernimmst du die technische Architektur sowie die hands-on Entwicklung und Integration einer plattformübergreifenden Anwendung. Dabei verbindest du deine Expertise in Software Engineering, Full-Stack Development und DevOps, um eine skalierbare, sichere und langfristig wartbare Lösung zu realisieren.

Deine Aufgaben:
• Konzeption und Umsetzung der Gesamt- und Detailarchitektur einer plattformübergreifenden Softwarelösung mit lokaler und containerisierter Betriebsvariante
• Entwicklung und Integration intuitiver Benutzeroberflächen ( GUI ) für lokale Anwendungen und Web-Applikationen sowie Implementierung der serverseitigen Geschäftslogik
• Design und Implementierung von Datenbanklösungen auf Basis von PostgreSQL , SQLite oder vergleichbaren Technologien inklusive Datenverwaltung, Versionierung und Nachvollziehbarkeit
• Umsetzung von Benutzer- und Rollenverwaltung, Berechtigungskonzepten sowie Import-, Export- und Verwaltungsfunktionen
• Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung containerisierter Infrastrukturen mit Docker und Kubernetes inklusive CI/CD-Pipelines , automatisierter Tests und Deployment-Prozessen
• Konzeption und Integration von API-Schnittstellen sowie optionaler ETL/ELT-Prozesse zur Anbindung externer Datenquellen
• Sicherstellung der plattformübergreifenden Nutzung unter Windows und Linux sowie Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Klassifizierungs- und Open-Source-Lizenzvorgaben
• Durchführung von Unit- und Integrationstests sowie Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen, Betriebsanleitungen und Benutzerhandbücher

Dein Profil:
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik (HF, FH, Universität) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit fundierter praktischer Erfahrung
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Software- und Solution Architecture sowie in der Konzeption und Entwicklung komplexer Softwarelösungen
• Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Full-Stack-Entwicklung, insbesondere in der Umsetzung von Web-Applikationen, Benutzeroberflächen und Backend-Systemen
• Praktische Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken wie PostgreSQL und SQLite sowie idealerweise mit datenbankgestützten Verwaltungsoberflächen wie Baserow
• Gute Kenntnisse in der Containerisierung und Orchestrierung mit Docker, Docker Compose und Kubernetes
• Erfahrung mit DevOps-Praktiken, Git, CI/CD-Pipelines, automatisierten Tests sowie Monitoring und Logging
• Kenntnisse in der API-Integration und Datenverarbeitung, idealerweise mit Python, ETL/ELT-Prozessen und Apache Airflow
• Vertrautheit mit Open-Source-Technologien sowie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung plattformübergreifender Anwendungen für Windows und Linux
• Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die technische Dokumentationen
• Sauberer Leumund ist zwingend

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per i nostri clienti del settore pubblico, stiamo cercando un esperto Software & Solution Architect per progettare e implementare una soluzione software moderna e supportata da database. In questo ruolo versatile, si assume l'architettura tecnica e lo sviluppo pratico e l'integrazione di un'applicazione multipiattaforma. Unisci la tua esperienza nell'ingegneria del software, nello sviluppo completo e DevOps per realizzare una soluzione scalabile, sicura e manutenbile a lungo termine.

I vostri compiti:
• Concezione e realizzazione dell'architettura complessiva e dettagliata di una soluzione software cross-platform con variante operativa locale e containerizzata
• Sviluppo e integrazione di interfacce utente intuitive (GUI) per applicazioni locali e applicazioni web, nonché implementazione di logica aziendale lato server
• Progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni di database basate su tecnologie PostgreSQL, SQLite o simili, tra cui gestione dei dati, versione e tracciabilità
• Attuazione delle funzioni di gestione dell'utente e del ruolo, dei concetti di autorizzazione e delle funzioni di importazione, esportazione e gestione
• Stabilimento e sviluppo di infrastrutture containerizzate con Docker e Kubernetes, tra cui tubazioni CI/CD, processi automatizzati di test e di distribuzione
• Progettazione e integrazione di interfacce API e processi ETL/ELT opzionali per la connessione di sorgenti di dati esterne
• Garantire l'uso cross-platform in Windows e Linux, nonché la conformità ai requisiti di sicurezza, classificazione e licenza open source
• Attuazione dei test unitari e di integrazione e preparazione della documentazione tecnica, delle istruzioni operative e dei manuali d'uso

Il tuo profilo:
• Formazione completa in informatica (HF, FH, università) o qualificazione comparabile con esperienza pratica approfondita
• Diversi anni di esperienza nell'architettura del software e della soluzione, nonché nella concezione e nello sviluppo di soluzioni software complesse
• Conoscenza approfondita nello sviluppo completo, soprattutto nell'implementazione di applicazioni web, interfacce utente e sistemi di backend
• Esperienza pratica con database relazionali come PostgreSQL e SQLite, e idealmente con interfacce di gestione basate su database come Baserow
• Buona conoscenza della containerizzazione e dell'orchestrazione con Docker, Docker Compose e Kubernetes
• Esperienza con le pratiche DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, test automatizzati, monitoraggio e registrazione
• Conoscenza dell'integrazione API e dell'elaborazione dei dati, idealmente con i processi Python, ETL/ELT e Apache Airflow
• Familiarità con le tecnologie open source e l'esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni cross-platform per Windows e Linux
• Metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione con una mentalità pronunciata
• Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e buona conoscenza dell'inglese per la documentazione tecnica
• Clean Leumund è obbligatorio

descriptionByLocale.en:
For our customers from the public sector, we are looking for an experienced Software & Solution Architect to design and implement a modern, database-supported software solution. In this versatile role, you take on the technical architecture as well as the hands-on development and integration of a cross-platform application. You combine your expertise in software engineering, full-stack development and DevOps to realize a scalable, secure and long-term maintainable solution.

Your tasks:
• Conception and implementation of the overall and detailed architecture of a cross-platform software solution with local and containerized operating variant
• Development and integration of intuitive user interfaces (GUI) for local applications and web applications as well as implementation of server-side business logic
• Design and implementation of database solutions based on PostgreSQL, SQLite or comparable technologies including data management, versioning and traceability
• Implementation of user and role management, authorization concepts and import, export and management functions
• Establishment and further development of containerized infrastructures with Docker and Kubernetes including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and deployment processes
• Design and integration of API interfaces and optional ETL/ELT processes for connecting external data sources
• Ensuring cross-platform use under Windows and Linux as well as compliance with security, classification and open source license requirements
• Implementation of unit and integration tests and preparation of technical documentation, operating instructions and user manuals

Your profile:
• Completed training in computer science (HF, FH, university) or comparable qualification with in-depth practical experience
• Several years of experience in software and solution architecture as well as in the conception and development of complex software solutions
• In-depth knowledge in full-stack development, especially in the implementation of web applications, user interfaces and backend systems
• Practical experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and SQLite, and ideally with database-based management interfaces such as Baserow
• Good knowledge of containerization and orchestration with Docker, Docker Compose and Kubernetes
• Experience with DevOps practices, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring and logging
• Knowledge of API integration and data processing, ideally with Python, ETL/ELT processes and Apache Airflow
• Familiarity with open source technologies and experience in developing cross-platform applications for Windows and Linux
• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working method with a pronounced hands-on mentality
• Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English for the technical documentation
• Clean Leumund is mandatory

jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for an experienced System Support Engineer (m/f/d) who will be responsible for installing, maintaining, supporting, and troubleshooting Diagnostic Systems throughout their entire lifecycle, from development to post-launch.

In this role, you will provide technical expertise across hardware and software support, system qualification (IQ/OQ), preventive maintenance, technical troubleshooting, and system servicing. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure reliable system performance, compliance with quality standards, and efficient technical support of diagnostic systems across development and global trial environments.

Start date: asap/by arrangement

Planed Durration: 12 Months (extension possible)

Workload: 80-100%

Contract Type: Contracting

Location: Rotkreuz

Remote: on side

Your Tasks:
• You manage commercial and medical sponsoring activities throughout their entire lifecycle—from initial approval and contract support to gathering, reviewing, and archiving all required documentation (attendee lists, event reports, photos, receipts) to ensure a complete audit trail.
• You screen incoming sponsorship requests and supporting documents (official request letters, detailed agendas, overall event budgets, up-to-date HCP CVs). Review compliance due diligence checks for HCOs and HCPs, and prepare sponsorship and engagement agreements (mostly in German, some in English) using standard templates.
• You evaluate requests against internal Roche policies and the Swiss Medtech Code. Screen for key risk factors (e.g., events held during ski season, purely tourist destinations, inappropriate entertainment or side programs, and gifts to HCPs).
• You set up new vendors/creditors (HCOs, HCPs, event agencies) and create/approve Purchase Orders (POs).
• You track and coordinate financial steps through to invoice verification and approval workflows.
• You act as the key point of contact for external sponsoring requesters and doctors' associations (coordinating event logistics/approvals), as well as internal business owners, event management, marketing, medical affairs, and local/global compliance teams.
• You maintain audit-ready, compliant records and file all process-related documents in line with information compliance standards.
• You review the existing end-to-end GSD process from start to finish to reduce operational complexity.
• You identify gaps, manual bottlenecks, and redundant handoffs.
• You develop, revive, and roll out practical solutions to digitize, simplify, and streamline workflows (including updating roles and responsibilities).

Your Profile:
• You have a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree (Master’s degree preferred), ideally in Law, Compliance, Business Administration, or a related field, to effectively engage with highly educated stakeholders.
• You have 3–5 years of proven experience in healthcare compliance, ethics compliance, legal operations, or sponsorship management within the Pharma or MedTech industry.
• You bring solid working knowledge of the Swiss Medtech Code (mandatory—legal background alone is not sufficient) and MedTech Europe guidelines.
• You have a good understanding of relevant Swiss healthcare law (e.g., TPA/HMG, TPO/VAM) and basic familiarity with broader regulatory frameworks (such as IVDR).
• You are business fluent in both German and English (written and spoken), as most contracts are in German (with some English contracts for the French-speaking region).
• You have proficiency in MS Office; highly self-driven, flexible, detail-oriented, and pragmatic project/stakeholder manager with strong communication skills.

Nice to have:
• You bring prior experience with internal systems, processes, and compliance policies.
• You have hands-on experience opening/onboarding new suppliers and creating/managing Purchase Orders (POs).
• You have practical experience with disclosing transfers of value under Swiss Medtech and MedTech Europe rules.
• You speak French

• Contracting
• Part Time, 80-100%
• asap - 1 Year contract

Per il nostro cliente, stiamo cercando un esperto ingegnere di supporto di sistema (m/f/d) che sarà responsabile per l'installazione, il mantenimento, il supporto e la risoluzione dei problemi sistemi diagnostici durante tutto il loro ciclo di vita, dallo sviluppo al post-lancio.

In questo ruolo, fornire competenze tecniche attraverso il supporto hardware e software, la qualificazione di sistema (IQ/OQ), la manutenzione preventiva, la risoluzione dei problemi tecnici e la manutenzione del sistema. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i team interfunzionali per garantire prestazioni di sistema affidabili, conformità con gli standard di qualità e un supporto tecnico efficiente dei sistemi diagnostici attraverso lo sviluppo e gli ambienti di prova globali.

Durata prevista: 12 mesi (estensione possibile)

Carico di lavoro: 80-100%

Tipo di contratto: Contratto

Posizione: Rotkreuz

Telecomando: sul lato

I vostri compiti:
• Gestisci le attività di sponsorizzazione commerciale e medica in tutto il loro ciclo di vita, dall'approvazione iniziale e dal supporto contrattuale per raccogliere, rivedere e archiviare tutta la documentazione richiesta (elenco di esperti, report eventi, foto, ricevute) per garantire un percorso completo di audit.
• Si visualizzano richieste di sponsorizzazione in arrivo e documenti di supporto (lettere di richiesta ufficiali, agenda dettagliata, budget per eventi globali, CV HCP aggiornati). Verificare la conformità dei controlli di diligenza per HCO e HCP, e preparare accordi di sponsorizzazione e di impegno (soprattutto in tedesco, alcuni in inglese) utilizzando modelli standard.
• Valuta le richieste contro le politiche Roche interne e il Codice Medtech svizzero. Schermo per fattori di rischio chiave (ad esempio, eventi tenuti durante la stagione sciistica, mete puramente turistiche, intrattenimento inappropriato o programmi collaterali, e regali per HCP).
• Hai istituito nuovi fornitori/creditori (HCO, HCP, agenzie di eventi) e creare / approvare ordini di acquisto (PO).
• Traccia e coordina i passi finanziari attraverso la verifica della fattura e i flussi di lavoro di approvazione.
• L'utente agisce come punto chiave di contatto per i richiedenti sponsor esterni e le associazioni dei medici (coordinando logistica/omologazioni degli eventi), nonché per i proprietari di affari interni, gestione degli eventi, marketing, affari medici e team di compliance locali/globali.
• L'utente mantiene i record di audit, conformi e archivia tutti i documenti relativi al processo in linea con gli standard di conformità delle informazioni.
• Si esamina il processo GSD end-to-end esistente dall'inizio alla fine per ridurre la complessità operativa.
• Identifichi le lacune, le strozzature manuali e le manopole ridondanti.
• Sviluppi, rianima e sviluppi soluzioni pratiche per digitalizzare, semplificare e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro (compreso l'aggiornamento di ruoli e responsabilità).

Il tuo profilo:
• Hai un minimo di un diploma di laurea (la laurea preferita da Master), idealmente in Diritto, Compliance, Business Administration, o un campo correlato, per impegnarsi efficacemente con parti interessate altamente istruite.
• Hai 3–5 anni di esperienza comprovata nella compliance sanitaria, nel rispetto dell'etica, nelle operazioni legali o nella gestione della sponsorizzazione nel settore Pharma o MedTech.
• Porti solide conoscenze di lavoro del Codice Medtech svizzero (obbligatorio-solo background legale non è sufficiente) e le linee guida MedTech Europe.
• Hai una buona comprensione del diritto sanitario svizzero rilevante (ad esempio, TPA/HMG, TPO/VAM) e la familiarità di base con i più ampi quadri normativi (come IVDR).
• Lei è fluente di affari sia in tedesco che in inglese (scritto e parlato), come la maggior parte dei contratti sono in tedesco (con alcuni contratti inglesi per la regione francofona).
• Hai competenza in MS Office; direttore di progetto/stakeholder altamente guidato, flessibile, orientato ai dettagli e pragmatico con forti capacità di comunicazione.

Bello da avere:
• Porti una precedente esperienza con sistemi, processi e politiche di conformità interne.
• Hai esperienza pratica apertura / onboard nuovi fornitori e la creazione / gestione ordini di acquisto (PO).
• Hai esperienza pratica con la divulgazione di trasferimenti di valore secondo le norme Swiss Medtech e MedTech Europe.

jobs.description:
Do you have a strong experience in the analytical development of synthetic drug substances with a specialization for peptides? Then you might be the team member who we are looking for!

Your responsibilities:
• You serve as the Analytical SME/analytical project lead (APL), driving the development of state-of-the-art analytical control packages for synthetic molecules, including direct materials, IPCs, intermediates, and crude APIs.
• You actively contribute to portfolio delivery by ensuring efficient and effective process development analytics, including the adoption of modern techniques like modeling and simulation.
• You coach technicians and junior scientists on project work and serving as a central point of contact for project-related information
• You supervise internal laboratory activities and / or testing activities at CLOs/CDMOs
• You collaborate cross-functionally with key partners in research and early development, Regulatory, and Quality to ensure seamless project execution and alignment.
• You author, review, and approve critical documents and regulatory dossiers (e.g., QIMPD, NDA) while ensuring compliance with quality standards and data integrity.
• You act as a Chemistry Project Lead (CPL), leading external testing activities at CDMOs or CLOs.

Your background:
• A Master's or Ph.D. in chemistry, pharmacy, or a related field.
• Min. 5 years of professional experience within the analytical development of synthetic peptides.
• You have a robust foundation in liquid chromatography (HPLC and UHPLC) with proficiency in various detection methods, including UV, Mass Spectrometry (MS), fluorescence, and charged aerosol detection.
• You possess a solid understanding of analytical chemistry, particularly chromatographic techniques (HPLC, GC), titrations, and various physicochemical methods.
• You demonstrate excellent collaboration, technical supervision, and project management skills, with a structured and rigorous approach
• Digital acumen to support digital transformation initiatives; familiarity with statistical analysis of analytical data is also advantageous

jobs.title: Customer Operations Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client in Ticino , we are looking for an experienced and open-minded Customer Operations Specialist .

In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide technical, order, and payment-related assistance/support to the internal and external customers. Each day, you will coordinate with relevant stakeholders to obtain complete case ownership. You will also showcase your expertise by improving customer satisfaction.

Your Tasks:
• Ensuring the resolution of customer issues by coordinating with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Trade Compliance Team, Chamber of Commerce, and other internal and/or external teams
• Recommending appropriate solution for customer requests and coordinating with the related teams to ensure end-to-end handling of the request (e.g., production capability and scheduling, resourcing, quotes, price lists, invoice, etc.) is in place
• Keeping the customers proactively informed on the issue status based on the inputs received and clarifying their doubts
• Preparing and analyzing regular statistics (e.g., Revenue Forecasts, Requested Delivery Dates) using available tools and collecting additional relevant information and tracking regular sales performance against the target and sharing insights with the management
• Ensuring timely cash collection and support accounts receivables reconciliation

Your Profile:
• At least 3–5 years of professional experience in commercial order handling
• Good knowledge of Incoterms 2010, Free Trade Agreements and Export Control regulations (products, third parties and countries)
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, SAP SD, Outlook and Teams, ideally with advanced SAP user skills
• A positive attitude combined with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset
• A strong sense of responsibility, with a collaborative and customer-focused approach
• A completed education in Commercial Administration or Commercial Processing, or an equivalent qualification
• Excellent communication skills in English and Italian

jobs.title: MSAT Microbial Process Validation Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For a leading company in the biopharmaceutical industry, we are looking for an experienced MSAT Microbial Process Validation Specialist to strengthen the Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) team at its site in Visp, Switzerland.

In this role, you will provide scientific and regulatory expertise in the validation of biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes, with a particular focus on microbial processes. You will be responsible for developing and implementing process validation strategies, designing and executing validation studies, and ensuring compliance with internal quality standards and global regulatory requirements.

Furthermore, you will play a key role in Continued Process Verification (CPV) and Product Quality Reviews (PQR), contributing to the ongoing monitoring, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of validated manufacturing processes. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will help ensure robust processes, regulatory compliance and successful validation activities throughout the product lifecycle.

Hard Facts
• Start Date: 01 December 2026
• End Date: 31 July 2027
• Contract Duration: 8 months
• Workload: 100% (41 hours per week)
• Location: Visp, Switzerland
• Work Environment: Biopharmaceutical Manufacturing / MSAT
• Working Hours: Standard daytime working hours
• Travel Requirements: No regular travel required

Tasks and Responsibilities
• Develop and implement process validation strategies in accordance with internal Validation Master Plans (VMPs), SOPs and applicable global regulatory requirements.
• Prepare, review and author validation documentation, including study designs, validation protocols and final reports.
• Support R&D teams during process characterization activities, ensuring the appropriate execution of validation-related tasks.
• Review and assess process characterization documentation to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and internal quality requirements.
• Coordinate validation assessments related to process changes and deviations, including the review and approval of associated change control and deviation documentation.
• Develop, implement and maintain Continued Process Verification (CPV) plans to ensure ongoing process monitoring and control.
• Review and approve Product Quality Reviews (PQRs), ensuring compliance with applicable quality standards.
• Participate in and facilitate cross-functional risk assessments to define the scope and requirements of validation studies and activities.
• Evaluate validation data against predefined protocol acceptance criteria and support deviation investigations, impact assessments and the definition of appropriate corrective actions.
• Act as a process validation subject matter expert during customer audits and health authority inspections.
• Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance Operations (QA Ops) to support batch release activities for processes under validation.
• Support validation training initiatives and coach or mentor junior employees in MSAT validation activities.
• Organize and facilitate cross-functional meetings to ensure effective collaboration with MSAT, QA Validation, Cleaning Validation and QA Qualification teams.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Microbiology, Biochemical Engineering or a related Life Sciences discipline.
• At least 5 years of professional experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
• Proven experience in Process Development, Process Validation and/or Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).
• Strong knowledge of Continued Process Verification (CPV), Product Quality Reviews (PQR), GMP requirements and applicable regulatory guidelines.
• Experience with microbial processes and biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
• Practical experience in developing, reviewing and authoring validation protocols, reports and related quality documentation.
• Experience in deviation management, change control, risk assessments and validation-related investigations.
• Fluent English skills, both written and spoken. German is considered an advantage.

Personal Competencies
• Adaptable and comfortable working in dynamic environments with changing priorities and complex challenges.
• Strong analytical and decision-making capabilities, combined with sound business acumen.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
• Collaborative mindset and the ability to establish effective working relationships across different functions.
• Strong customer orientation and a results-driven approach.
• High level of integrity, accountability and ownership.
• Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and deliver results within agreed timelines.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interfunzionali, vi aiuterà a garantire processi robusti, conformità normativa e attività di validazione di successo durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

You will be responsible for developing and implementing process validation strategies, designing and executing validation studies, and ensuring compliance with internal quality standards and global regulatory requirements.

Furthermore, you will play a key role in Continued Process Verification (CPV) and Product Quality Reviews (PQR), contributing to the ongoing monitoring, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of validated manufacturing processes.
